note: Phase 13.1: `signal` is an ordinary function in Emacs -- (special-form-p 'signal) is nil there -- and its arm here evaluates every operand, but it had no row in fe_eval.c's primitive_is_function[], so funcall rejected it as a special form with `invalid-function signal`. The raise now reaches the host carrying the condition the program asked for. Measured before the fix: fe answered the invalid-function condition instead.
